notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A finetune of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 32.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-05-06.
